notes: NoeHill's own pages for San Francisco's city landmarks, California historical landmarks and National Register listings, plus its points of interest. Much of each page quotes the landmark designation report or the National Register form, both already mined (article-10-landmarks, nrhp-nominations); those quoted passages were read but not re-taken. Taken: NoeHill's own dated statements about a building or site, its plaque texts, and notable past residents it names. Errors found in the source are left out and named in the dossier's cautions.

coverage.remaining: Nothing on the 682 pages fetched. Five linked pages returned errors and were not read. Not taken: passages attributed to Wikipedia or quoted from designation reports and National Register forms already mined, places in federal parks or with no street number, and four statements the source gets wrong (the 1920 convention's nominee, the Bloody Thursday date, two hotel opening years).
